description: JavaScript API for Drupal's History module, implementing client-side caching and user-specific read status tracking.

methods.name: fetchTimestamps
methods.description: Fetches 'last read' timestamps for specified nodes, either from embedded data or via AJAX request.

methods.name: getLastRead
methods.description: Retrieves the last read timestamp for a specific node, using embedded data or local storage.

methods.name: markAsRead
methods.description: Marks a node as read by storing the timestamp client-side and optionally notifying the server.

methods.name: needsServerCheck
methods.description: Determines if a server check is needed based on content age and read timestamps.
